name: Final threshold follows Ultramassive, keeps continuous mass, and remains final at extreme mass
Natural final evolution awards its point and achievement once, then growth adds no phantom classes
The final stage, achievement, simulation time and original slot state survive a real save/load
A preceding-class checkpoint loads as Ultramassive with its mass and momentum intact
Ring filaments animate in both detail settings while the central shadow stays opaque
Reduced motion freezes the final render while accretion still changes its feeding intensity
Paused and photo views do not spin the rings as the renderer clock advances
Rendering has no simulation, RNG, save, listener or animation-loop side effects and only two bounded atlases
Sandbox exposes the final class and never grants its journey achievement
Final-stage restart clears cached atlases and transient matter without duplicate listeners or loops
Final-stage accretion remains delayed and transfers a captured parcel through the existing simulation
